items.name: Orange Chicken Meatballs
items.desc: These healthy, baked chicken meatballs are epic! Loaded with protein, and coated in a tasty orange chicken sauce, they're a little spicy, a little sweet - and a whole lot of deliciousness!

items.name: Our Favorite Turkey Burger Entree
items.desc: Where's the beef? Who cares? With this burger, even those who think they don't like turkey will likely change their minds! Juicy and packed with flavor, this is a healthy upgrade to your standard meat-and-potatoes dish.

items.name: Pot Roast Stuffed Baked Potato
items.desc: Down-home comfort food at its finest. We take your favorite meat and potatoes and pack them full of flavor and nutrition!

items.name: Breakfast Burrito Bake
items.desc: It's a favorite dish mashup - combining a breakfast burrito and a breakfast pizza! You can eat this deliciousness without feeling sluggish or guilty afterwards.

items.name: Take & Bake Zuppa Toscana Casserole
items.desc: It's your midwestern dream come true - a favorite soup turned into a healthy and hearty hot dish! Layers of a creamy sauce swim amongst bacon, Italian sausage, potatoes, and just enough kale to make you feel like you're slaying the healthy eating game.

items.name: Apple Pie Parfait
items.desc: High in protein and flavor, this parfait has it all: honey-vanilla yogurt, local apples to create a pie-like filling, and homemade granola!

items.name: Creamy Chicken & Wild Rice Soup
items.desc: We've lightened up a comfort food classic. This hearty soup is loaded with protein, local vegetables, and flavor!
